jobs.title: Cabin Crew — Freshers Welcome
jobs.location: Delhi / Mumbai / Bengaluru / Multiple bases, India
jobs.description: Join IndiGo cabin crew. Freshers with strong communication and customer service mindset can apply when recruitment drives are open. Full training after selection.
eligibility: Age typically 18–27 years (as per current airline drive)
Unmarried (often preferred for fresher cabin crew drives)
Female height usually 155 cm+ / Male 170 cm+ (with proportionate weight)
Fluent English; Hindi or regional language an advantage
Clear skin, no visible tattoos on arms/neck/face while in uniform
Willing to work on shifts and relocate to base cities

jobs.title: Customer Experience Executive — Airport
jobs.description: Front-line Customer Experience role at the airport: passenger assistance, queue management, special handling (UM, PRM), and service recovery. Ideal for hospitality / service freshers.
eligibility: Graduate or final-year graduate preferred; 10+2 considered for some locations
Comfortable with standing duties and rotating shifts
No criminal record; background verification required

jobs.title: Cabin Crew Recruitment — Freshers
jobs.location: Delhi NCR / Hyderabad / Multiple cities, India
jobs.description: SpiceJet cabin crew openings for Indian nationals. Freshers encouraged for walk-ins and online drives. Training provided after selection.
eligibility: Indian citizen with valid ID proof
Good command of English; Hindi preferred
Height and weight as per SpiceJet medical standards
No major medical history; fit for flying duties
Ready for rostered shifts and night stops

jobs.title: Guest Experience Associate
jobs.salary: As per Air India / GHA norms
jobs.description: Deliver premium guest experience at touchpoints — check-in support, lounge coordination assistance, disruption handling and feedback capture for Customer Experience department.
eligibility: Prior hospitality / retail / BPO experience is a plus (freshers welcome)
Shift flexibility including nights and weekends

jobs.title: Cabin Crew / In-Flight Services — Freshers
jobs.description: Air India cabin crew and in-flight service roles. Fresh graduates and first-time applicants can apply through the official careers portal when positions are listed.
eligibility: Age as per current Air India notification
Meets height, BMI and grooming standards of the airline
Valid passport preferred (or ready to apply)
Medically fit for cabin crew duties

jobs.title: Customer Experience Officer — Domestic Terminal
jobs.description: Own passenger journey metrics at the terminal: complaint resolution, NPS feedback, service standards audits and coordination with ground handling partners.
eligibility: Graduate with 0–2 years in CX, hospitality or aviation
Ability to handle irate customers professionally
Willing to work early morning / late night shifts

jobs.title: Cabin Crew — Entry Level
jobs.description: Akasa Air entry-level cabin crew. Freshers with positive attitude and service orientation welcome. Check official careers page for open drives.
eligibility: Age 18–26 years (indicative — confirm in drive ad)
Willing to be based in Mumbai / Bengaluru or other bases

jobs.title: Passenger Experience Coordinator
jobs.description: Support Customer Experience team with on-ground passenger care, irregular operations (IRROPS) assistance and brand experience delivery at the airport.
eligibility: Team player; can work under time pressure

jobs.title: Baggage Services Agent
jobs.description: Baggage handling, reclaim, PIR (Property Irregularity Report) support and coordination with airlines for mishandled baggage — GHA operations.
eligibility: Physical fitness for baggage area duties

jobs.title: Airport Customer Service Executive
jobs.description: Passenger check-in, boarding gate support and customer handling at major Indian airports. Ideal fresher role — training on airline systems provided.

jobs.title: Customer Care Executive — Airline Contact Centre
jobs.description: Voice / chat customer experience for domestic airlines: bookings, changes, refunds, web check-in help and flight status. Night shifts common.
eligibility: Graduate preferred; 12th pass accepted for some processes
Ready to work in rotational shifts (24×7 ops)

jobs.title: Passenger Service Agent — Ground Handling
jobs.description: AI SATS ground handling: check-in, boarding, arrival services and passenger assistance for airline clients at major Indian airports.
eligibility: Physically fit for long standing hours
Willing to work early/late airport shifts
Local language of base city is an advantage

jobs.title: Airport Operations Executive — Ground Handling
jobs.description: dnata ground handling operations support: passenger and ramp coordination, SLA monitoring and airline client liaison at metro airports.
eligibility: 0–3 years in GHA / airline ground ops
Knowledge of DCS systems is a plus

jobs.title: Check-in & Boarding Agent
jobs.description: Globe Ground India: check-in, boarding, arrival and transfer passenger services for contracted airlines.
eligibility: Can work standing for long hours
Valid local address proof for joining

jobs.title: Airline Ticketing / Reservations Executive
jobs.description: Domestic airline ticketing support (IndiGo, SpiceJet, Air India fares). GDS knowledge is a plus; freshers with ticketing course can apply.

jobs.title: Aircraft Maintenance Technician Trainee
jobs.salary: As per AME training / airline norms
jobs.description: Entry path for AME students and aircraft maintenance freshers supporting domestic fleets (A320 family etc.). DGCA pathway preferred.
eligibility: Willing to work shifts in MRO hangars

jobs.title: Airport Security Screener (AVSEC) — Freshers
jobs.description: Passenger and baggage screening support roles. Clean background required. Freshers may join after security awareness / AVSEC training as applicable.
eligibility: Shift work at airport security points

jobs.title: Graduate Trainee — Aviation Operations
jobs.description: Structured pathway for 12th pass / graduates into cabin crew, ground handling, customer experience and airport roles with airline & GHA partners.
eligibility: Ready to complete QATI partner training if required
Willing to relocate to airport base cities

jobs.title: Ramp / Loading Officer
jobs.description: Celebi ground handling ramp operations: aircraft loading/unloading, baggage, ULD build-up and ramp safety for airline partners.
eligibility: Physically fit; able to lift baggage as per safety norms
Ready for outdoor ramp work in all weather

jobs.title: Customer Service Agent — GHA
jobs.location: Delhi / Mumbai / Kolkata / Multiple stations, India
jobs.description: Bird Airport Services: passenger handling for airline customers — check-in counters, gate duties, lost & found support and transfer assistance.
eligibility: Graduate or 12th pass with good communication
No colour blindness for some ramp-adjacent roles

jobs.title: Load Control / Weight & Balance Trainee
jobs.description: Trainee load controller with Menzies Aviation ground handling: load sheets, weight & balance and departure control support after training.
eligibility: Attention to detail under time pressure
Willing to work early departures / late arrivals
